s: Echad niknas etzel shelosha sheakelu, ubo b' seipim: shelosha sheakelu vehem mebarekim bezimmun veniknas echad shello akal, im niknas kesheamar hambarek: "nebarek sheakalnu mishshello" — chayyab laanot acharayv: "baruk umeborak shemo tamid leolam vaed", veshub eno oneh "amen" achar "baruk sheakalnu", kemo shennitbaer besiman qtz"h. Veim mezammenim baasara — oneh acharayv: "baruk elohenu umeborak shemo tamid leolam vaed". Vehu haddin im haya sham kesheakelu velo akal immahem. Veim lo ana acharayv kak, o shenniknas keshehamsubbin onin: "baruk sheakalnu", sheeno yakol laanot: "baruk umeborak", kevan shello shama sheamar hambarek: "nebarek" (veap ledibre haomerim shemmi shello shama "bareku" mishsheliach tzibbur yakol laanot im hatztzibbur — kan eno yakol laanot im hamsubbin, shehem onim: "baruk sheakalnu", vehu lo akal, velaanot bipne atzmo gam ken eno rauy, kevan shello shama) — yaaneh acharehem "amen", veshub eno oneh achar "baruk sheakalnu" shechozer hambarek. Veen tzarik lomar babberakot haggemurot sheyyesh bahen hazkarat hashshem, shechayyab laanot acharehem "amen" ap al pi sheeno chayyab bahem. Veim niknas keshehambarek chozer veomer: "baruk sheakalnu" — yesh omerim shetztzarik laanot acharayv "amen". Veyesh omerim sheen tzarik, shekkevan shehamsubbim sheakelu hem shoteqim — en alayv shum chiyyub kelal (veyesh lachosh lassebara harishona):

Vekol zeh keshehu lo akal velo shata, abal im akal kezayit yaraq o dabar acher, o shata rebiit meezeh mashqeh, velo berak adayin beraka acharona veniknas etzlam — yakol laanot immahem: "baruk sheakalnu mishshello", ap al pi shello akal immahem bachabura achat ella bebayit acher. (Vaapillu niknas beshaa shekkol hamsubbin onin — oneh immahem: "baruk sheakalnu", ap al pi shello shama "nebarek", kevan sheoneh im hamsubbin sheshshameu, lepi dibre haomerim ken be"bareku"):
